name: weighted edge block lift
description: You lift a weight off the floor with one hand on a small edge block, instead of hanging from a board. It builds finger strength with a load you can adjust in small steps.
instructions: Hang a weight from an edge block with a 15-20 mm edge.
Bend your knees and hips, keep your back flat and place your fingers on the edge, usually in a half crimp.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulder pulled down.
Stand up to lift the weight just off the floor.
Hold for the set time, then lower it under control.
Rest, then repeat with the other hand.
